svg.title: Peblo first-run onboarding: four steps
svg.desc: Mid-fidelity wireframe of Peblo's first-run flow in four frames: 1) welcome, name and theme, no account; 2) choose AI setup: local with Ollama, cloud with your own key, or skip; 3) import from Notion, Obsidian or Markdown; 4) learn quick capture with a live try-it box.
svg.text: First run: about 90 seconds, every step can be skipped
No account, no email. Enter moves forward, Esc skips a step, and everything can be changed later.
